# Experiment results (generated by experiments/run_experiments.py)

Protocol: [PROTOCOL.md](../PROTOCOL.md). Every row is generated from `runs.csv`. d_* = method − raw on identical test rows; negative favours the method. `worse_*` counts runs where the method was worse than raw by more than 1e-12. These describe the listed scenarios only.

- Seeds: 1–20
- Scheduled runs (rows incl. raw): 1160; failed rows: 0
- Adult: run: OpenML data_id 1590, 48842 rows, prevalence 0.2393
- Wall-clock: 37.1 s total (study A 1.5 s)
- Hardware: arm64 arm / Darwin 25.6.0; Python 3.11.1
- Libraries: numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, pandas 3.0.6, scikit-learn 1.9.1, matplotlib 3.11.2, jinja2 3.1.6, pydantic 2.14.1, typer 0.27.3, rich 15.0.0
